statements.t: While initial sales progress has been more gradual than anticipated, we are encouraged by the underlying launch fundamentals.
Importantly, we have identified clear opportunities to improve performance, and we remain confident in TRYNGOLZA's long-term growth potential.
Our commercial revenue growth was driven by DAWNZERA, which continues to gain momentum, supporting our confidence in achieving full-year DAWNZERA product sales guidance.
These results keep us on track to achieve our 2026 total revenue, operating loss and cash guidance,” said Elizabeth L.
“We are lowering our 2026 TRYNGOLZA product sales guidance to reflect a more gradual ramp than we anticipated.
We remain confident in TRYNGOLZA’s potential to deliver sustained, long-term revenue growth and multi-billion-dollar peak sales.

in the endeavor of building a business around such medicines

statements.t: As a pioneer in RNA-targeted medicines with a deep understanding of disease biology and an industry-leading drug discovery technology, we are driven to deliver innovative, life-changing advances for patients.

Our key recent achievements, combined with our independent and partnered product launches anticipated by the end of 2027, position us well to help millions of patients with serious diseases and deliver increasing product and royalty revenue.
● Assessing the appropriate estimate of anticipated future royalty payments under our royalty purchase agreement

We expect our operating expenses, excluding non-cash compensation expense related to equity awards, to continue to increase during the remainder of 2026 as we advance our commercialization activities.
We use our proprietary technologies to generate information about the function of genes and to determine the value of genes as drug discovery targets.
We expect SG&A expenses to increase as we continue to invest in our independent commercial launches.
We currently intend to use our cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments to finance our activities.
